name: online-game-hub
description: Server-authoritative multiplayer web game platform monorepo

scripts.lint: pnpm format:check && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && pnpm docs:check && pnpm deps:check
scripts.surface:publish: turbo run build --filter=@online-game-hub/surface-artifact && node tooling/surface-artifact/src/cli.ts publish
scripts.surface:verify: turbo run build --filter=@online-game-hub/surface-artifact && node tooling/surface-artifact/src/cli.ts verify
scripts.test:database: turbo run build --filter=@online-game-hub/game-server && pnpm --filter @online-game-hub/database test:database && pnpm --filter @online-game-hub/game-server test:database
